NHL Hockey - Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs

The Maple Leafs host the Senators at Scotiabank Arena. Ottawa won the final three meetings of the 2025-26 season to sweep the series. Toronto relies on William Nylander (79 points in 2025-26), while Tim Stützle leads Ottawa (83 points in 2025-26).
NHL Hockey - Calgary Flames at Vancouver Canucks

The Canucks host the Flames for an NHL game at Rogers Arena. Calgary earned a 7-3 victory over Vancouver in March 2026, paced by forward Matt Coronato. Vancouver relies on winger Jake DeBrusk to defend its home ice in this Pacific Division clash.
